name: float-sweep-check
summary: Decide whether a Float-managed, ENS-named business should sweep idle USDC into (or out of) its tokenized-Treasury position, and how much — then execute the swap through the Uniswap v4 Permissioned Pool.

ensName.description: The business's ENS name, e.g. rosa-design.float.eth

amount.description: USDC, decimal string. Omit to let Float recommend.

steps.description: Resolve {{ensName}} to its resolver + address record.
Ask Float's metered endpoint whether the sweep is allowed and for how much.
Execute the recommended sweep through the permissioned Universal Router.

before_after.before: The agent guesses an amount and either over-sweeps (breaching the working-capital buffer) or under-sweeps (leaving yield on the table); it has no view of the business's KYC status or per-tx cap.
before_after.after: One paid call returns allowed=true|false, the exact recommendedAmount that respects the buffer + upcoming obligations + the per-transaction cap, and a reason — the swap step just executes it.
